data.name: Raging Leaper
data.description: You are always considered to have a running start when attempting an Acrobatics check to jump. In addition, you gains a +8 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump. Finally, if you fall, you halve the total distance fallen for the purposes of determining damage taken from the fall.
